details:
========
EDIT: I changed post because it's my mistake. I thought it's logout button, but it's just button to old main menu. Quit button is near it - so it looks kinda related to logout. Because the tooltip bar is below, i didn't read it and so no paying attention. I am sorry for my mistake. I changed post in better version.
========

I will make request for Exit idea. Can you move the Exit icon to Launch Pad so quit VRChat will more easier, because it needs 3 clicks to quit. (Launch Pad -> Settings -> Exit button -> Confirm)

And also because the Main old menu is still much used, it's kinda weird to make icon button small. Maybe it should more bigger on Launch Pad with name below for visual as normal button.

Then the logout button. I understand it's not much used button except you have Quest so you might share VR with your friend or girlfriend. Then logout is needed to change account. To use function, it needs 3 or 4 clicks.
If main menu button can placed big on Launch Pad (easier to click due bigger button) then we can put Logout icon there where the "resize icon" is now.

And..... The Logout button has no Confirm step. This is weird. You added Confirm step to Exit button - but exit is less painful, because restart vrchat and because you don't need login step - you're in already. Yeah, no worries.
The logout will have less nice login way if you use VR, so it's more awkward because you need move headset up to see your smartphone. This is why the confirm is needed for logout to avoid mistake click. So it's indeed a problem if you click by mistake on Logout - you must go through less great login steps - thus more worrying about it by mistake click.
Even more if you're streaming, you must NOT show login step to others in stream, means by mistake - you must censor the login step by switching to another layer to hide it for safety part... that is also not nice.

The Settings tab has not all functions, so you use same resize icon above for it. The tooltip is only bit weird: "Go to the Main menu for more options", because it goes immediately to Settings. So should you not write it like: "Go to Settings window in the main menu"? We can also say "Go to advanced Settings window". 
It's weird because in Launch Pad,  the icon tooltip has exact same tooltip text.
You can even make it normal big button - because i found also bit weird to use big buttons for FPS, Ping and even Version number. That is a lot room for small menu, and there is still room below for some text, yes indeed, enough room for text FPS, Ping and Version Number.

And the last: can you add the clock / date in Launch Pad? Some people have overlay for it, some not, And not in Quest. Clock in new menu panel might have good use for some people.

That are the ideas. You can give comment on some ideas.
title: Move "EXIT" button to Quick menu / Launch Pad tab (and other menu ideas)
